slots.notes: Row of full-bleed course-category photos filling the right-side accordion of .c6-card panels (native placeholders: Editing Module, Editing Module, Commerce Journey). Each image is absolutely positioned, height:100% width:auto and horizontally centered (top:0; left:50%; translateX(-50%)), so it is cropped on the sides as its panel expands/collapses between flex 0.8 and flex 2.5 on hover. A dark bottom gradient (::after rgba(0,0,0,0.6)->transparent) plus a side gradient overlay sit on top for white text legibility, so supply tall portrait-friendly photos with the subject roughly centered and tolerant of heavy side-cropping and a darkened lower third. card:3 is the placeholder count; the accordion lays out however many cards are provided. No transparency needed (full photographic fill).

Single typeface used for the entire hero (logo wordmark, nav links, giant 'Study. Train. Rise.' H1, search field + button, card titles/topic counts, vertical category labels, and footer line). Native family 'Outfit' (Google Fonts, weights 300/400/500/600/700) loaded via an index.html <link>, set as body font-family with sans-serif fallback. The 5.5rem -2px-tracking headline and the 2.2rem card titles are tuned to Outfit's geometric proportions, and the .c6-card-title uses white-space:nowrap so a wider replacement face can overflow.

mechanic: A single full-viewport split hero pairs a left 'Study. Train. Rise.' headline plus pill search box with a right-hand horizontal accordion of three photo cards that expand/collapse via flex (0.8<->2.5) on hover, cross-fading a vertical category label into a bottom title/topic-count overlay, all driven by pure CSS transitions and collapsing to a 300px scroll-snap carousel on mobile.
techDelivery: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript single App.tsx component with a hand-authored src/index.css (Tailwind base/components/utilities directives are included but the hero uses bespoke .c6-* CSS classes, not Tailwind utilities); all motion is CSS transitions/transforms (no Framer Motion, no @keyframes, no SVG, no icon library); Outfit font via index.html <link>; lucide-react and @supabase/supabase-js are declared as deps but unused by this hero.
reskinNotes:
Several colors are baked as literal hex in CSS outside the :root token block, so retinting needs CSS edits not token swaps: the search button's split gradient hardcodes green #8BBF77 over the --accent peach, and the .c6-vertical-text label background hardcodes near-black #1C1D2D. All copy is hardcoded in App.tsx: the 'Learnly.' wordmark (the '.' is a styled accent, not text data), the four nav labels (Chase dreams/Collection/Trades/Students), 'Enter', 'Try It Now', the 'Study.
Train.
Rise.' headline (literal
line breaks), the 'Chase your dreams' search placeholder, the 'Up' button label, the three cards' titleTop/titleBottom/label/num values in the inline cards array, the 'Topics' unit label, and the footer 'Boundless passes to 100+ mentorships.' line. Layout is font-metric-dependent: the 5.5rem/-2px headline and 2.2rem white-space:nowrap card titles assume Outfit's geometry, so longer copy or a wider face can overflow the nowrap titles or break the headline line count. Card images are not transparency- or aspect-locked but are center-cropped and bottom-darkened, so off-center or light-on-bottom subjects lose legibility behind the white overlay text.
